svg.aria-label: Case board: bugs found in public Helm charts, each reproduced on a throwaway kind cluster. 10 cases, 6 reported by us, 3 with a fix in review, 3 of ours fixed upstream. SeaweedFS: First upgrade restarts the filer and S3 gateway (HB-UV-003, seaweedfs#11720, fixed). JupyterHub: First upgrade restarts the hub and the proxy (HB-UV-003, jupyterhub#3997, fix in review). Semaphore: First upgrade restarts Semaphore (HB-UV-003, semaphoreui#35, fix in review). yugabyte: Patch release changes a selector; upgrades fail (HB-CU-001, yugabyte#240, reported). SeaweedFS: Unquoted number or boolean in env fails install (HB-SCAN-004, seaweedfs#12137, fixed). SeaweedFS: Reinstall writes a new filer database password (HB-RI-004, seaweedfs#12138, fixed). Jenkins: Argo CD replaces the admin password on every sync (HB-GR-001, jenkinsci#1026, reported). docker-registry: haSharedSecret changes on every upgrade (HB-UV-001, twuni#187, reported). docker-registry-ui: App version in the selector breaks upgrades (HB-SCAN-001, Joxit#22, fix in review). grafana: Admin password changes on every upgrade (HB-UV-001, grafana#62, fixed). Checked 2026-10-28 from the GitHub API.
